meta.name: Wikan
meta.primaryGoal: Read books that permanently change how I think.

readerProfile.corePhilosophy:
I value books that introduce one profound assumption and explore its consequences with exceptional intellectual discipline.

I prefer inevitability over surprise.

I enjoy books that feel like discovering a theorem rather than consuming a story.

readingModes.Borges: Read slowly. Every paragraph matters. Assume every sentence is intentional.
readingModes.Lem: Interrogate every argument. Push back mentally.
readingModes.Greg Egan: Build the model. Follow logical consequences.
readingModes.Hofstadter: Trust the flow. The structure eventually reveals itself.
readingModes.Hesse: Trust accumulation. Listen more than analyze. Ask high-level questions instead of local ones.

Sushi.definition: Books that permanently reshape how I think.

Pickled Ginger.definition: Books that are enjoyable without fundamentally changing my worldview.

Wikan Shape.definition: One premise. Relentless consequences. Avoid arbitrary expansion.

readerBlindSpots.undervalued: Character-driven stories and emotional realism — I value them, but they work best as subtle undercurrents, not primary drivers.

readingEvolution.insight: Thought I primarily loved hard science fiction.
Discovered Borges. Realized literary style can produce intellectual wonder.
Increasingly recognize that intellectual discipline in execution — not just ambition — determines whether a book becomes sushi.
Books are organized by questions, not genres.

activeQuestions: What makes a book intellectually inevitable?
What separates deep exploration from endless worldbuilding?
Can a novel function as philosophy without sacrificing its literary qualities?
What makes Borges feel infinitely rereadable?

currentReading.notes:
Do not rush to understand the Game itself. Instead understand why a civilization would create it.

Reflection at 25%: The monastery's inclusion of art resonates with my childhood goal of balancing left and right brain. Noticing that my own reading still leans left — even this book is being processed as an intellectual structure.

highestPriority.reason: Expected to strongly match interests in recursion, consciousness and mathematics.
